scenes.title: Nottingham Food Process Hall (Historical Brochure)

Page 9 separately illustrates jacketed pans and a wheeled ice-cream machine. PDF metadata dates the brochure to 2013; present arrangement is not verified. The lower page-4 photograph is a separate quality-control laboratory and is not combined with the hall. Page-9 equipment placement in the hall is unknown. No food thermal/rheological process or biological model.

scenes.title: Warwick 1 GHz NMR Apparatus (Installation Reference)
scenes.institution: University Of Warwick — UK High-Field Solid-State NMR Facility, 1 GHz magnet room
scenes.reference_notes: The official installation photographs show a tall cylindrical magnet supported on three isolated columns, a temporary mobile scaffold, a low pump cart, long overhead service ducts and high wall windows. A close view establishes top service necks and flexible connections; the room corner and side workbench are visible. The operational facility is confirmed by its current official page, while the reviewed geometry photos document 2021 installation/commissioning. Scaffolding, crates and coverings are temporary and must not be presented as the permanent experiment layout. No current whole-room survey, OEM CAD, magnetic field, RF or spectral solver is verified.
